info.title: BigQuery API

requests.description: Lists all projects to which you have been granted any project role.
requests.name: GET /projects
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Lists all datasets in the specified project to which you have been granted the READER dataset role.
requests.name: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new empty dataset.
requests.name: POST /projects/{projectId}/datasets
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the dataset specified by the datasetId value. Before you can delete a dataset, you must delete all its tables, either manually or by specifying deleteContents. Immediately after deletion, you can create another dataset with the same name.
requests.name: DELETE /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns the dataset specified by datasetID.
requests.name: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates information in an existing dataset. The update method replaces the entire dataset resource, whereas the patch method only replaces fields that are provided in the submitted dataset resource. This method supports patch semantics.
requests.name: PATCH /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates information in an existing dataset. The update method replaces the entire dataset resource, whereas the patch method only replaces fields that are provided in the submitted dataset resource.
requests.name: PUT /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists all models in the specified dataset. Requires the READER dataset role. After retrieving the list of models, you can get information about a particular model by calling the models.get method.
requests.name: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/models
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the model specified by modelId from the dataset.
requests.name: DELETE /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/models/{modelId}
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the specified model resource by model ID.
requests.name: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/models/{modelId}
requests.note: Replace {{BIGQUERY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
